newsitem.title: GERMANY: N. Rhine-Westphalia Feb consumer prices rise 0.5%.
newsitem.headline: N. Rhine-Westphalia Feb consumer prices rise 0.5%.

text.p: The German state of North Rhine-Westphalia said on Tuesday that February consumer prices rose 0.5 percent month-on-month and 2.0 percent from February 1996.
The state was the final of four German states to report consumer price data, which are used to compute provisional west German inflation.
Earlier, Bavaria said February consumer prices rose 0.4 percent from January and 1.6 percent from February 1996.
Baden-Wuerttemberg said February consumer prices gained 0.4 percent month-on-month and rose 1.7 percent year-on-year.
The state of Hesse had also said consumer prices there rose 0.3 percent month-on-month and were up 1.5 percent year-on-year.
